in_hebrew.name: Morrie
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Morrie הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word μωρός (moros), meaning ‘foolish’ or ‘simple’. This name may have also been associated with the Latin word mori meaning ‘to die’ and the Greek word μορεά (morea), meaning ‘sea’. In Christian tradition, Morrie could symbolize the wisdom that comes from humility and faith, as embodied by figures such as St. Moritz and St. Morellus.
